agent_notes: The official iiml.ac.in identity and Lucknow campus were independently confirmed; the official contact page lists the Lucknow campus at Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow 226013 and separately lists the Noida campus.

The main academic catalogue establishes nine current degree or doctoral programmes. The official Executive Education page additionally lists Executive General Management, Business Accelerator, and long-duration partner-associated executive offerings; current or ongoing entries were retained when the official page showed registration open and a current/future commencement window.

The Executive Education page contains stale or conflicting registration-open entries, and its central page does not consistently state credential type or eligibility for each partner-associated offering. The short-duration MDP calendar is a rotating event catalogue, and expired defence/MFMTTP events were excluded. This leaves the certificate/executive catalogue only partially verifiable, so manual_review is required.

No programme specializations were invented; specializations were used only when present in the official programme name or description. Healthcare Management has no responsible matching node in the local career tree.
The career_path.db was queried read-only; it was not edited.

Normal TLS verification first produced the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain' on the public DuckDuckGo request. After confirming the expected search and official hostnames, public GETs used curl --insecure only; no credentials or private data were sent.
